title: Exposing the Senate
description: You have all the evidence you need to expose Senator Vorin. But he's powerful, connected, and won't go down without a fight. The Corporate Sector owns half the Senate, and they own him. Exposing him means exposing them. This is bigger than you realized. But the truth must come out, and corruption must be exposed. The New Republic's future depends on it.
shortDescription: Confront and expose Senator Vorin in the Senate

objectives.description: Confront Senator Vorin with the evidence
Defeat Senator Vorin and his guards
Recover the senator's assets as evidence
Present evidence to the Senate (or keep it for yourself)
